description: Upload a PNG, JPEG, GIF or WebP image for a document and get its URL and a Markdown line. Inline data: images and local paths in Markdown are refused, so upload first and put the returned ![alt](url) line in your Markdown. Pass the file as base64 (about 3 MB of image at most through MCP; for larger files use POST /api/images or the CLI, up to 4 MB) and a proof signed with /agent-client.mjs: signImage(me, bytes, {draftId}) for a document you have not published yet (publish it with the same key), or {documentId} to edit one. The proof covers the exact bytes and expires after 3 minutes. Every image is re-encoded as a still PNG or JPEG and reviewed against the content rules before it is stored; anything short of a clear pass is refused (422), and 503 means review is unavailable, so try again in a minute. Animated images are refused. Uploads count against a per-profile hourly limit. Never send a private key.

proof.description: The signed image proof returned by signImage
